preciseMissingCapability.description: One coherent opt-in draw-funded distinct-basic-use capability family covering all real basic Use entry points, with a by-method actual-turn name ledger and exact native payment/return.
preciseMissingCapability.policyNameStatus: Design proposal only; not accepted loader JSON, not an opcode, and not a source-ready production contract.
preciseMissingCapability.qualification: At the published acceptance boundary, owner is alive, hand count equals HP, the entire current hand has one real effective red or black color, and the desired basic name has not already been actually used by this method in this actual turn.
preciseMissingCapability.cost: Exactly one native Draw1 for the owner, with its real movement/gain/HP/dying children drained once before the selected basic use/semantic-use response continues. A decline must occur before paying this cost; there is no free-draw skip after payment.
preciseMissingCapability.names: Normalize the three Slash kinds to one Slash name using ProgramBasicCardName. Keep Dodge, Peach and Alcohol separate. The existing current Basic kinds are Slash, FireSlash, ThunderSlash, Dodge, Peach and Alcohol.
preciseMissingCapability.nameHistory: Emit a dedicated immutable scalar fact at the exact real issuance boundary, with owner, semantic ability ledger ID, actual turn number, normalized name, exact action/origin ID and exact source skill/binding/instance/hash. Only issued Bingxin uses populate this ledger; all ordinary and foreign uses are irrelevant.
preciseMissingCapability.ledgerScope: Owner + stable by-method ledger + actual actual-turn number + normalized name; exact instance is issuance provenance. Whether regrant/reacquisition shares the same semantic ledger must be explicitly decided, rather than inheriting an accidental per-instance reset.
preciseMissingCapability.pendingReservation: Before Draw1 children can re-enter the same ability, retain the chosen name and original use purpose on the owning frame. An in-flight reservation prevents paying the same method/name twice while final real-use history remains distinct from a merely offered or interrupted attempt.
preciseMissingCapability.physicalIdentity: The resulting use has zero physical cards, genuine declared effective Basic kind, and neutral suit/rank where the shared no-material convention applies. The drawn physical card is a draw benefit/cost receipt, never synthetic use material.
preciseMissingCapability.exactParent: Persist the original Play/forced-Slash/own-Dodge/Dying parent kind and frame/action/target/responder tuple. Resume only that parent after the drawn-card children, and preserve a paid receipt if the source is subsequently lost.
requiredNativeDirections: Own Play: real Slash variants, self Peach when legal, self Alcohol with normal quota/forbidden-card checks.
Forced actual Slash Use: BorrowedSword and Qinglong follow-up where the native route classifies the action as Use; ordinary Duel/Barbarian response-only Slash is excluded.

Own Slash-defense Dodge semantic Use: retain exact incoming Slash owner/target proof; ArrowBarrage, Hujia/Jijiang provision and response-only routes do not gain an offer merely because CardActionType is Response.
Dying: real Peach rescue for a legal victim, and Alcohol for owner self-rescue, returning to the original dying frame.
Native modifiers: genuine finalized target, cancellation/prohibition, no-response, armor, Slash/Alcohol quotas and completion observers remain active.
preciseMissingCapability.parserAndReplay: Use an additive optional policy whose omitted/null value preserves every old accepted JSON body and canonical hash. Strictly constrain Basic output, genuine zero input, semantic-use-only direction and one exact draw cost; do not relax the tiered policy or route all old virtual uses through changed behavior.
preciseMissingCapability.aiAndPrivacy: Generate published legal actions from the actor own private hand; no other player view may expose hand identities or effective colors. AI must select only published source/targets and draw at most once; it must not bypass the command actor or payment boundary.
preciseMissingCapability.eventProjection: Prefer scalar source/name/payment facts. Any new collection-bearing fact, receipt or prepared view must freeze nested collections and receive CommittedEventProjection coverage; pending state stays on its owning resolution frame, not a use-ID sidecar.

assertions: Hand-count/HP mismatch, mixed effective colors, illegal output or prohibited target publishes no ability action and pays no draw.
Choose a legal Slash/Peach/Alcohol, then exactly one real draw/gain movement occurs; a movement/HP child pauses before real use. Wrong actor/stale choice is rejected and preserves state.
Cold restore at unpaid, paid-child and returned-use boundaries resumes the same source and exact parent; no second Draw1, no physical card0 move and no invented material.
A physical ordinary use of a name does not consume the by-method allowance; a real Bingxin use blocks that same normalized name, including elemental Slash variants.
Distinct names remain available only when current qualification is true again. Extra Play within the same actual turn does not reset names; the next actual turn does.
Source loss after accepted payment does not pay again or attach the return to another source/instance.

assertions: Own Slash-defense Dodge pays Draw1 once, creates one genuine accepted semantic Use response and cancels the original Slash; its Bingxin Dodge name is then unavailable.
Actual ArrowBarrage/Hujia provision and Duel/Barbarian Slash played responses never gain Bingxin offers or consume its names.
Forced actual Slash Use preserves original target/source and normal quota/distance semantics; declined or illegal choices do not pay.
Actual Peach rescue and self Alcohol rescue pay once, keep correct actor/provider/victim and return to the original dying resolution across cold restore.
The entire drawn-card child stack drains before return; exact missing/tampered receipt, parent/action/name or source mismatch is rejected.
Prepared player views do not reveal private hand/color evidence to foreign viewers; any new event collections and receipts cannot be mutated through observers.
